compliance.settlement_party: Jacobson decision (Third Round); no specific FSHC/NJBA settlement noted for Fourth Round

notes: HEFSP prepared June 2, 2025; filed with NJ Courts June 30, 2025 (BER-L-000825-25). Prior Round obligation (1987-1999) = 0. Third Round obligation = 447 units (per Jacobson decision); RDP = 392; achieved 455 credits (8 surplus). Fourth Round present need = 333 (very high rehabilitation obligation); Fourth Round prospective need = 221; VLA established RDP = 72; Unmet Need = 149. As a VLA municipality, must address 25% of adjusted obligation (149 x 0.25 = ~37 units) through overlay/redevelopment zoning. Fourth Round plan identifies 6 sites providing 163 affordable units and 559 bonus credits for total of 234 credits (well in excess of 72 RDP). Borough heavily relies on 100% affordable and municipally-sponsored development leveraging bonus credits. Present need of 333 is notably high — addressed through Bergen County Home Improvement Program and other rehabilitation programs. Key Fourth Round sites: Route 5 Senior Housing (Blocks 724/725/726; 90 units, 18 affordable age-restricted), NE corner 14th & Edsall (Block 433, Lots 1/3/2/4/5/6; ~118 units, 100% affordable, municipally-sponsored), Bellview Place (Block 217, Lot 23; 20 units, 100% affordable municipal), 100 Grand Ave (Block 104, Lots 16-17; 20 units, 4 affordable), 125-135 Grand Ave (Block 502, Lots 8-10; 16 units, 3-4 affordable), 550 Bergen Blvd (Block 416, Lot 3; 40 units, 8 affordable).

sites.site_name: 100 Grand Avenue (100 Grand Av Inc. Inclusionary)

sites.quote: 100 Grand Avenue Inc. (Block 104, Lots 16 and 17) – Proposed Inclusionary Housing Site. The site located at the intersection of West Edsall Boulevard and Grand Avenue consists of approximately 0.529 acres and comprises two separate tax lots. It is situated within the AHMUD (Affordable Housing Mixed-Use Development) Overlay Zone, which permits multi-family residential development at a density of up to 40 units per acre. ... a 20% set-aside for affordable housing applies, resulting in a minimum of 4 affordable units
sites.notes: Two lots totaling 0.529 acres within existing AHMUD Overlay Zone. Owner: 100 Grand Av Inc. Approximately 20 units at 40 du/ac; 4 affordable (20% set-aside). Table 16 shows lots 16 (0.207 ac, 1.66 affordable units) and 17 (0.322 ac, 2.58 affordable units) = ~4 total affordable.

sites.quote: 125, 129 & 135 Grand Avenue (Block 502, Lots 8, 9, and 10) – Proposed Inclusionary Housing Site. The site consists of three contiguous tax lots located along Grand Avenue and totals approximately 0.41 acres. The properties are identified as Block 502, Lots 8, 9, and 10, and are under the ownership of Kyungkon Choi.
sites.notes: Three contiguous lots, single owner (Kyungkon Choi). Within AHMUD Overlay Zone at 40 du/ac. ~16 units; 20% set-aside = 3-4 affordable units. Document uses 'Block 502, Lots 8, 9, and 10' but Table 17 labels it '125, 129, 135 Grand Ave.' with 16 units and 3 credits. Also referred to as 'Block 502 Lots 8, 9 and 10' in the site suitability section which incorrectly cites address as '100 Grand Avenue'— the correct address per the section heading is 125/129/135 Grand Avenue.
